message: Lunch break ended, and it was time for afternoon classes.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let's get started... wait, huh？ Where's Setsugekka？」

name: Momiji
message: 「She said she was going to the convenience store for lunch.」

name: Iori
message: 「So she's late, then. That's rare.」
Setsugekka might look laid-back, but she's surprisingly conscientious and always operates on schedule.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka is such a handful. I'll have to scold her later.」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on now, once in a while is fine, isn't it? It's not really worth getting so worked up over.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Absolutely not. If you coddle that girl, she'll just get carried away.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, I get that. I can picture it perfectly right now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Shingan no Kiwamete is convenient, isn't it?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahahaha, Momitchi is convenient~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, would you mind not unjustly disparaging my Kiwamete？」
While we were busy chattering away like that—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Outta my way！ I'm comin' through！！」
Suddenly, someone leaped into the classroom.

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'm Arakawa Sonomi, second year in the Martial Arts Division！！ Pleased to meetcha！」
Arakawa Sonomi stood planted on top of the teacher's podium, looking down at everyone.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And I'm Kazamine Setsugekka, disciple number one to Sono-chan-senpai！ Pleased to meetcha！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka.」
What on earth is she doing?

name: Setsugekka
message: （I'm sorry, Teacher Muragaki, please let me play along with this persona for just a moment, I beg of you!）
Setsugekka whispered hurriedly into my ear.

name: Sonomi
message: 「So, is there someone named Suzakuin Momiji in this class！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji is this person right here.」
Momiji pointed at Ririmu.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, why are you pinning it on me！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I mean, this looks like it’s going to be a hassle...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're a wicked one, Momitchi!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Senpai, it's her. The one with the bored-looking face.」
With a brisk flick, Setsugekka points straight at Momiji.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh, so you're the one...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka-san, would you kindly stop giving me away?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What's with that weird way of talking?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, I'm always like this, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's Momiji-san in her honor student mode.」
She's probably putting on airs because Arakawa Sonomi is here.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, what might it be?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'm challenging you to a duel. Step outside for a sec...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, how frightening. Might I decline？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Whoa, hey, are you serious?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「What, so the heir to the Suzakuin name is just a good-for-nothing who's all name and no substance？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you wish to know my strength, I'll show you at the Martial Festival.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh？ Your senior came all the way over here in person, and you're gonna send me home empty-handed？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If you're the leader of martial artists, show me you've got some actual stature.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoaaa... Sono-chan-senpai, you're so freaking cool！」
Come to think of it, Setsugekka did say she admires heels. So that's why she brought Arakawa-san along.

name: Iori
message: 「Welcome, Arakawa Sonomi-san. I'm Muragaki Iori, the assistant homeroom teacher for this class.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I got no business with Teach, so butt out.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if you say that, we're about to start class.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Like I give a damn about that. The only one I've got business with is Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, requesting Momiji by name, huh? Sure, got it. I'll lend Momiji to you, then.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hwah？！ Wait a second, Iori-sensei？！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh... you're a teacher who actually talks sense, aren't ya」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, Momimomi's being sold out」

name: Momiji
message: 「Teacher, isn't that cruel！？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, Arakawa-san is right, you know」

name: Iori
message: 「I mean, it'd be a shame to send a senior student home empty-handed when she went out of her way to visit」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s only right that Momiji steps up to spar with her」

name: Momiji
message: 「...So, what’s your real reason？」

name: Iori
message: 「Arakawa Sonomi, second-year in the Martial Arts Division. Passed the Martial Festival preliminaries in her first year, eliminated in the first round of the main tournament」

name: Iori
message: 「She’s one of the top two strongest in the second year of the Martial Arts Division, and she has a high chance of making it to the main Martial Festival tournament again this year」

name: Iori
message: 「This is a great chance to measure the skills of a formidable student. I want everyone to observe Arakawa-san's fighting style」

name: Momiji
message: 「So you want me to be the scapegoat？」

name: Iori
message: 「Matches are fun, Momiji！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You think that’s gonna fool me!」

name: Iori
message: 「So, Arakawa-san, if you don't mind our students watching, I'd really like you to spar with Momiji」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If I get to go against a Suzakuin, I don't care what it is」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eeeehhh...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoaah, getting to see Sono-chan-senpai fight in person is the best！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So glad I brought her along！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, you’d better remember this later...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then everyone, let's head to the training grounds！」
